text:
marco: bringing up a new Llama->Qwen converted artifact (zephyr-lite) and seeing a subtle BLEU drop on code-synthesis evals. latency and logits look fine but top-k choices differ for numeric literals.

marco: quick reproducer: `python eval.py --model /mnt/models/zephyr-lite-qwen/ --task codegen --quant int4 --beam 5`

lena: any tokenizer diffs? numeric literal tokenization often causes off-by-one mapping when special tokens are remapped.

marco: ran token id diff for sample snippet: `def add(a, b=0): return a + 1` -> token ids differ at '=' and '1'. upstream ids: [1234, 5678], converted: [1235, 5679].

adele: that implies a global offset applied during conversion. Did converter run with `--preserve-specials`?

marco: converter args: `--from=llama --to=qwen --quantize=int4 --shift-ids yes --preserve-specials no`

lena: ugh. we've seen that pattern: converter applies a shift to align vocab shapes then loader applies rotary-head remap and kvcache index assumptions mismatch. combined they nudge generation to pick different numeric tokens.

build-bot: automated sanity check failed: token-id-diff > threshold for top-20 frequent tokens. Marking artifact: quarantine=true

marco: quick experiments: 1) reconvert with `--preserve-specials`, 2) load with `rotary_head_scale: disable`, 3) run eval with exact-token-remap applied.

adele: also diff the sin/cos rotary tables headwise; fractional drift (e.g., 0.9998 vs 1.0) on per-head freq arrays can bias autoregressive decoding for numeric tokens in code.

marco: ran reconvert + preserve_specials -> BLEU recovered from 0.412 -> 0.439. disabling headwise scaling got 0.444 (very close to upstream).

lena: sounds like the same two-factor failure we saw in INFR-214. Action items: change converter default to preserve specials, add a conversion-time smoke that compares top-50 token ids and logs rotary L2 norm, and flag conversions that both shift tokens and change rotary norms.

adele: I'll open a small PR for the conv-smoke and add unit tests.

triage-bot: Opened ticket INFR-336 "converter: token-shift + rotary-norm smoke" and linked to INFR-214.

marco: catalog update: quarantined artifact and scheduled reconversion. will re-run full benchmark after PR lands. thanks all :thumbsup:
